## 1. One-paragraph verdict
Real valid WAV parent fixture: RIFF size 0x8a16 (35350 body+8 = 35358), `WAVE` + `fmt ` + `LIST`
+ `data`. Consumed as THE canonical PCM fixture across CLI container tests, demux wav/aiff tests,
soak lanes (fixture rotation), and the compat-matrix raw-rows. Structure matches the recorded
truth in crates/demux/tests/wav_aiff_fixtures.rs ("fmt 16 + LIST INFO + data 35280 B = 8820
frames"; 35280 data bytes / 4 B per stereo s16 frame = 8820 frames — arithmetically consistent).
